stories.title: Incêndio que destruiu prédio da UFPE afetou cerca de 200 teses e dissertações; pesquisadores têm bolsas prorrogadas

en.title: Fire that destroyed UFPE building affected approximately 200 theses and dissertations; researchers have scholarships extended
en.summary: A fire destroyed a building at the Federal University of Pernambuco, damaging around 200 graduate theses and dissertations. The federal government will extend scholarships for affected researchers in master's, doctoral, and postdoctoral programs.

stories.title: Violência, corrupção, economia: veja as propostas de Flávio Bolsonaro e de Lula para os temas que mais preocupam os brasileiros

en.title: Violence, corruption, economy: see proposals from Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula for issues that concern Brazilians most
en.summary: Two presidential candidates advanced to a runoff election, with violence, corruption, and economy identified as the top concerns for Brazilian voters. Each candidate has proposals addressing these key issues.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em acabar com reeleição e aumentar o próprio mandato: entenda como mudança pode ocorrer

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes ending reelection and extending presidential term: understand how change could occur
en.summary: A presidential candidate proposes eliminating the possibility of reelection while extending the presidential term length, which would require a constitutional amendment approved by Congress to take effect.

stories.title: Paes aceita decisão da Justiça, reconhece derrota e Ruas deve ser declarado governador do RJ; entenda

en.title: Paes accepts court decision, recognizes defeat and Ruas should be declared governor of RJ; understand
en.summary: A gubernatorial candidate acknowledged defeat in the Rio de Janeiro election after courts invalidated votes and rejected appeals, with another candidate set to be declared governor.

stories.title: Datafolha: 2º turno começa com vantagem estreita de Flávio Bolsonaro e caminho longo para Lula

en.title: Datafolha: Second round begins with narrow advantage for Flávio Bolsonaro and long path for Lula
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro holding a slim lead over Lula as the runoff election begins. The two candidates face different strategic challenges, with Bolsonaro needing to maintain support across regions while Lula must expand votes outside the Northeast.

stories.title: Indicado de Flávio para a Saúde trata atuação de Jair Bolsonaro na pandemia como 'capítulo superado'

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's health ministry nominee treats Jair Bolsonaro's pandemic response as 'closed chapter'
en.summary: Ophthalmologist Claudio Lottenberg, nominated to lead the health ministry in a potential Flávio Bolsonaro administration, characterizes Jair Bolsonaro's pandemic management as a matter best left in the past despite its marked scientific denialism.

stories.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro veem Lottenberg na Saúde como escudo na campanha contra negacionismo de Jair

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's allies see Lottenberg as shield in campaign against Jair's pandemic denialism
en.summary: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro view the appointment of physician Claudio Lottenberg as health minister as a defensive campaign strategy aimed at deflecting criticism regarding Jair Bolsonaro's conduct during the pandemic.

stories.title: Após reação, grupo Hypers Kids Africa promete devolver criptomoedas recebidas por vídeo pró-Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: After backlash, Hypers Kids Africa group promises to return cryptocurrency received for pro-Flávio Bolsonaro video
en.summary: The Hypers Kids Africa group, comprising children and youth from Uganda with 12.9 million Instagram followers, pledges to return 120 million $B22 tokens received for posting a video supporting candidate Flávio Bolsonaro following negative public reaction.

stories.title: Neymar manda indireta ao Palmeiras após empate: ‘Grande jogo dos dois melhores times do Brasil’

en.title: Neymar sends indirect message to Palmeiras after draw: 'Great game of the two best teams in Brazil'
en.summary: Neymar commented on a match between two Brazilian teams that ended in a draw, referring to them as the country's best sides.

stories.title: Paes reconhece derrota para Ruas no RJ e diz que respeitará decisão da Justiça

en.title: Paes acknowledges defeat to Ruas in RJ and says he will respect court decision
en.summary: Former Rio de Janeiro mayor Eduardo Paes stated he will accept a judicial decision that rejected a runoff in the gubernatorial election.

stories.title: Zanin nega pedido de Paes para suspender decisão do TSE que deve dar vitória a Douglas Ruas no Rio

en.title: Zanin denies Paes's request to suspend TSE decision that should give victory to Douglas Ruas in Rio
en.summary: A legal decision to reject Paes's request to suspend an electoral court ruling favoring Douglas Ruas in Rio de Janeiro's gubernatorial race was upheld.

stories.title: Flávio pede para Moraes renunciar após ministro pedir cumprimento da pena de Eduardo Bolsonaro

en.title: Flávio asks Moraes to resign after minister requests enforcement of Eduardo Bolsonaro's sentence
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro called for a minister's resignation following the minister's request for enforcement of a criminal sentence against Eduardo Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Lucros recorde de Samsung e SK Hynix impulsionam investimentos da Coreia do Sul em base industrial

en.title: Record profits at Samsung and SK Hynix boost South Korea's industrial base investments
en.summary: South Korean chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are generating record profits driven by artificial intelligence advances, with the companies contributing over 10 trillion won in tax revenue to support the country's industrial development.

stories.title: Para obter tungstênio, Mitsubishi Materials recorre ao Vietnã como alternativa à China

en.title: Mitsubishi Materials turns to Vietnam for tungsten as alternative to China
en.summary: Mitsubishi Materials is sourcing recycled tungsten from Vietnam to bypass Chinese export restrictions, though this costlier alternative forces the Japanese manufacturer to raise prices and risks competitive disadvantages.

stories.title: 'É possível ser inovador no mercado imobiliário, reduzir o risco e ganhar dinheiro'

en.title: "It is possible to be innovative in real estate, reduce risk and make money"
en.summary: French architect Greg Bousquet has built a career in Brazil combining architecture with efficient urbanism to add value to real estate developments, establishing himself as a reference for creativity and innovation across 17 states.

stories.title: Bairros planejados ampliam presença em todo o país

en.title: Planned neighborhoods expand presence across the country
en.summary: Planned neighborhoods designed on a human scale are emerging in various Brazilian municipalities, offering integrated living spaces with nearby schools, services, and recreation to reduce commuting and improve quality of life.

stories.title: MRV tem vendas 30% maiores no 3º trimestre na comparação anual

en.title: MRV posts 30% higher sales in third quarter year-over-year
en.summary: MRV&Co's incorporation division achieved R$ 3.04 billion in third-quarter sales, representing a 29.6% increase compared to the same period last year and marking a company record. The average ticket price rose 3.1% to R$ 276 thousand, while sales velocity improved with the VSO index increasing 3.5 percentage points annually to 25.1%.
